ui.avvisi_verificati_v4_10_4_app_mostra: Verified alerts (v4.10.4): the app only shows alerts signed by its own PC, so nobody can send fake ones; two old notification channels removed. More timely notifications (v4.10.3): when the network comes back after a period without signal, the app immediately starts receiving the PC's alerts again (before it could wait up to 5 minutes). Fixes (v4.10.2): after the first setup the Connection screen shows the saved addresses (before, saving from there lost them); ping shown only while the server is on; header title no longer overlaps the status.
ui.nome_voxarium_v4_10_1_accesso_fuori: Voxarium name (v4.10.1) and access from outside home without a tunnel (v4.10.0): HTTPS connection to the PC's public IP, recognized by its certificate fingerprint; new look like the PC panel.
ui.novita_smartphone_app_android_apk: What's new for smartphones (Android APK app):
ui.modalita_auto_wi_fi_internet_auto_app:
• Auto, Wi-Fi and Internet mode:
In Auto the app uses the home address on Wi-Fi and the internet one on mobile data, and switches between them by itself.

• Always up-to-date addresses:
When the PC's address changes, the PC sends it to the app in a signed message (ntfy): the app only accepts those from its own PC.

• Home Screen widget (2x2 / 4x1):
Server status, TPS, RAM and players with one-tap quick commands.

• Unlock with the PC PIN and notifications even with the app closed.
ui.app_6_lingue_v4_12_0_v4_12_3_pulsante: App in 6 languages (v4.12.0 – v4.12.3): language button in the top bar (IT, EN, ES, FR, DE, PT); changing language no longer reopens the app or asks for the fingerprint again; connection errors and notification types are translated too.
ui.ram_backup_v4_11_0_ram_server_scelta: RAM and backup (v4.11.0): server RAM picked from a list up to the PC's RAM; the backup window shows how big it will be; the unlock PIN is checked by the PC, so after a PIN change the new one works right away; app code protected.

pc.release_smartphone_v_build_novita:
Smartphone release: v{0} (Build {1})

PHONE-ONLY FEATURES:
• Information and updates shown only for the smartphone
• Smart network switching & automatic address updates (Wi-Fi ↔ 4G/5G)
• Addresses received automatically from the PC via ntfy, with a quick sync button
• Android Home Screen widget (2x2 / 4x1) with mobile network support
• Round info button (i) for the smartphone
• Remote config and mod editor
• Biometric and PIN unlock

PHONE VERSION HISTORY:
• v4.11.0: server RAM chosen from a list up to the PC's RAM (before at most 16 GB); the backup window shows how big it will be and whether it fits on the Desktop and on Google Drive, with the note about Google Drive for desktop; the unlock PIN is checked by the PC, so after a PIN change on the PC the new one works right away (before the app only accepted the old one and, retrying it by itself, got the phone locked out for 10 minutes); app protected with code obfuscation.
• v4.9.15: Italian accents and UTF-8 encoding fixed (-encoding UTF-8 in javac) in all texts, toasts and dialogs.
• v4.9.14: All app images and icons restored: official Minecraft icons in the header and dashboard, skin avatars for connected players, all graphic symbols restored in UTF-8 without corrupted characters.
• v4.9.12: Fixes from a live audit: online player count and list, backup confirmation with Google Drive choice and Cancel button, full handling of server states (Stop/Restart/Crash), gamerules from the server and real-time restore progress.
• v4.9.11: Automatic PIN authentication with the X-Admin-Token token, atomic APK download protected from truncation and ntfy listener with a 120s timeout.
• v4.9.10: Automatic two-way sync directly from /api/network with ntfy fallback.
• v4.9.8: Thorough 100% thread-safe review of all 9 server control screens; dynamic version subtitles on the Dashboard; URL/LAN normalization and protection.
• v4.9.7: Interactive mode buttons & automatic Wi-Fi/4G alignment; prevention of URL crashes on LAN.
• v4.9.6: Total silence: intrusive on-screen toasts for sync and mode changes removed; PC start/stop notifications fully silenced
• v4.9.5: Info screen dedicated only to the phone
• v4.9.4: Dynamic haptic mode buttons and automatic Wi-Fi ↔ 4G/5G switching
• v4.9.1: New compact info popup (i) and optimizations
• v4.8.6: 'Check for Updates' button unlocked and anti-Doze WakeLock
• v4.8.5: Full diagnostic window for Java crash reports
• v4.8.0: Automatic ZIP world backup restore from cloud/local
• v4.7.0: Priority push notifications through a dedicated ntfy channel
